title: Decent set; sloppy execution
text:
Decent set; sloppy execution. This set comes with 4 insulated food containers, 1 lunchbox, and 1 folding spoon. Everything fits perfectly into the lunchbox. I've used the containers to pack my lunch a few times, and so far they work well at keeping things warm for the few hours between when I pack and eat; I haven't tried with cold items.

My biggest complaint is that the thermal containers don't screw on very smoothly, so it makes you wonder if the lid is aligned correctly (it usually is). I haven't had any leaks or anything, but it's a little annoying screwing the lids on. Secondly, there is a little bit of sloppy construction on the bag. I circled what I mean in one of my pics. That said, the outside of the lunchbox appears to be fine, quality-wise.

Overall, not a terrible set. Though maybe a bit overpriced (at $36) for what you get.

features: 【Portable Lunch Containers Set】TiLeMiun portable lunch box set consists of 4 containers, 1 lunch bag and 1 folding spoon. Different foods such as pasta, soup, salad, fruit and snacks can be stored separately according to your preferences and needs. Avoid food mixing and ensure the original taste of the food. 【Keep Food Warm】The middle layer of the thermal lunch box is designed with PU foam filling, and the inner layer of the insulated lunch bag is aluminum foil, which can keep food warm for 2-3 hours. Convenient for you to enjoy delicious homemade food at school or work.

【Microwave Safe】Level Up! Compared with the common styles on the market. Our food containers have been crafted and upgraded. Keep food warm and microwaveable to ensure you can enjoy hot food every day. (Pay Attention! When you microwave, the lid needs to cover the lunch box, but it cannot be locked, and open the ventilation hole on the lid.)

【Leak-Proof】Each food container has separate lid with sealing silicone ring that prevents the spillage of sauces, salads and soups. There is a exhaust valve on the top of the lid, which can exhaust the air inside the container at any time, making the lunch box easier to open.

【Food Grade Material】Lunch container is made of food grade 18/8 stainless steel (internal) and plastic PP (external). They are reusable, durable, rust-proof, eco-friendly, BPA free and healthy. You can enjoy this hot food jar without any worries.
